notes.title: Dont let Master Spy sneak past you
notes.content:
I could use a lot of words and phrases to describe Master Spy that, when I read them in a game’s description, tend to put me off. Retro. “Hardcore”. Brutal. Platformer. Balaclava.

And yet I enjoyed it so much that I almost pitched a review a few years back. It’s tough, for sure, and I don’t think it’s the most approachable stealth platformer, but it feels fair. It doesn’t waste your time. If it had come out a few years earlier, it would probably have been pretty big. It can now be yours, along with literally over one thousand other games, as part of the Itch Bundle For Racial Justice And Equality.

(more…)

notes.title: New Easier Novice Mode - Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9189549/9d2aed30b9ddeab8c88f96bc838947f0f4520e86.png[/img]

[b]You've spoken, and we've heard - Master Spy has a new, easier Novice Mode![/b]

In this new Novice mode, we went through the code of almost every enemy and obstacle and reduced speeds and increased delays to try to create a less demanding, but still challenging game mode. 

We also spot checked a lot of the more demanding screens of the game, and removed or substituted obstacles that were more on the extreme side for this mode.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/fisHFHl8QazNc1nxzK/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]Additional Updates[/b]

The old novice mode is still intact as Operative Mode, and is the default mode.

If you had a saved game in progress, it will not be effected but the name will change to reflect whether it is the new Novice mode or Operative mode.

We also used this as an opportunity to review checkpoint placement, and we've added over 20 more checkpoints throughout the game (for Novice, Operative, and Level Select).

Additionally, we've added options in the pause menu that allow you to switch between Novice, Operative, and Narrative modes on the fly! This is so if anyone gets completely stuck on a level, they can switch to an easier difficulty just for that level so that they can continue to progress through the game. Do note that if used this will add the word "MIXED" to the final score screen next to the name of the game mode.

To celebrate the new update, Master Spy is on Sale! You'll want to catch this deal before it's too late!

-Kris

notes.title: Testers Wanted! New *Easier* Novice Mode
notes.content:
Hi all, we have a new build up in the test branch for Master Spy with a new easier Novice mode, and we'd love to have your feedback! (see below for how to test it out)

[b]The New Novice Mode [/b]

In this new Novice mode, we went through the code of almost every enemy and obstacle and reduced speeds and increased delays to try to create a less demanding, but still challenging game mode. 

We also spot checked a lot of the more demanding screens of the game, and removed or substituted obstacles that were more on the extreme side for this mode.

[b] Additional Game Updates [/b]

The old novice mode is still intact as Operative Mode, and is still the default mode.

We also used this as an opportunity to review checkpoint placement, and we've added over 20 more checkpoints throughout the game (for Novice, Operative, and Level Select).

Additionally, we've added options in the pause menu that allow you to switch between Novice, Operative, and Narrative modes on the fly! This is so if anyone gets completely stuck on a level, they can switch to an easier difficulty just for that level so that they can continue to progress through the game. Do note that if used this will add the word "MIXED" to the final score screen next to the name of the game mode.

[b]How to test out the new Novice Mode (you must already own Master Spy):[/b]
[list]
    [*]In your Steam Library, locate and right click on Master Spy
    [*]Select "Properties"
    [*]Click on the "Betas" tab
    [*]In the dropdown under "Select the beta you would like to opt into", select "test".
    [*]No beta code is required. You can now close the properties window and the update should automatically queue up for download.
[/list]

Feel free to share your feedback and thoughts on the forum thread here:

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/331190/discussions/0/3276824488713835872/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/331190/discussions/0/3276824488713835872/[/url]

Or chat with us on the [url=https://discord.gg/ewKEVkQ]TURBOGUN discord[/url]!

notes.title: Master Spy Narrative Mode + 3 Year Celebration
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9189549/84e0cec22199c49262dd00bf18614039bd64c97a.png[/img]

[b]New Mode: Narrative Mode[/b]

We're introducing a new Narrative mode that allows you to enjoy the levels, cutscenes, and RAC OST at your own pace [b]without getting caught[/b]!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/229Fha5CyikojLPAaI/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]Throw on the new ghost cloak in this mode to:[/b]

- Tame dogs and big cats. Whose a good boy? They are!
- Befuddle security guards and robots! They won't even see you coming!
- Render yourself impervious to assassin strikes, traps, and other dangers!

Can you find the hidden levels and unlock the alternate cutscenes? 

Also to celebrate the new update and 3 year anniversary, Master Spy is on Sale! You'll want to catch this deal before it's too late!

Other Notes:
-Also made a few small tweaks to levels

-Kris
